label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交为序列化、比较和深拷贝增加递归深度上限，超过上限时返回错误：这是在 harness 调用的 json_dumpb() 上新增的错误通道。表面上与“新增错误通道而 harness 不读取”的隐式 lifecycle 阳性相同。但 json_load_dump_fuzzer 本来就检查 json_dumpb 的返回值并据此释放资源，新的错误返回会被既有检查消化；定额 fuzz 下 dump 的深度检查代码在多个种子中被执行。harness 无需修改，属于隐式 lifecycle 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit adds a recursion-depth limit to serialisation, comparison and deep copy, returning an error beyond the limit: a new error channel on json_dumpb(), which the harness calls. On the surface this matches a silent lifecycle positive (a new error channel the harness never reads). But json_load_dump_fuzzer already checks json_dumpb's return value and releases resources accordingly, so the new error return is absorbed by existing checks; under the fuzz budget the depth check in dump runs in several seeds. No harness update needed: silent lifecycle negative.
